fusions.name: Wrenched Outcrop
fusions.desc: Tears a chunk of reef loose and hurls it at an enemy up to 6 tiles away for 12 damage, rising to 1.6 times that at full reach. It knocks the target back 3 tiles and leaves it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Picked-Up Hammer
fusions.desc: Brings a coral head down on the target two-handed for 30 damage. The blow is always a critical hit and leaves the target 15% easier to wound for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Heaped Rubble
fusions.desc: Rips up the reef and heaps it into a wall 5 tiles long for 6 seconds. Nothing crosses it, and anything that touches its jagged face moves 20% slower for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Hold What You Hit
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, your physical damage rises 25% for 5 seconds. Once every 8 seconds. Anything you strike moves 15% slower for 2 seconds, and your armour rises by 6%.
